basis: Frozen R1 trace and field anchor records; primary COPY builder not read/imported/executed.

consequences.CHOL: Two consecutive CHOL occurrences in P1 A remain ordered duplicates in copied P2 A and nested P3 A. They are not two independently written additions on either later paragraph.
consequences.KOL: The free KOL DY event appends one KOL to P3 A; its old DY-field constraint on P2.subject is removed. KOL is not thereby added to P2 A or inherited from it.
consequences.DOR: DOR remains in the P3 OR field description, whose DALOR reference points to P2.subject. That makes a retained B/reference constraint, not membership in P2 A or P3 copied A.
consequences.KCHOL: P1 DAIIN field descriptor only. It is absent from all three A lists and not copied.
consequences.SHOR: P1 CTHY field descriptor only. It is absent from all A lists and not copied.
consequences.YKEOL: Two consecutive YKEOL occurrences remain in all three expanded A lists, with the same copy provenance as CHOL.

forbidden_inheritances: COPY_A does not copy P1 CTHY descriptors SHOR/QOAIIN or P1 DAIIN KCHOL.
COPY_A does not copy P2 DAIIN DOL/OKCHAR or import later B constraints DOR/OTYDAL into A.
No copied description creates a new written OPCHAL/DAL naming anchor.
Remove DY field identities for OPCHALDY/DALDY and the KOL DY field event; retaining the old unified R1 entity description set would wrongly retain KOL on P2.subject.
DALOR and DALDAIIN retain prior-completed-paragraph P2 references, not the Q2 latest-current-occurrence rule.
scope: Copied list content is distinct from physical subject identity. The new A semantics is an ordered data list, not automatically a conjunction of simultaneously true physical properties.

If the separate signed-R1 complement and static-same-state semantics are additionally imposed on the copied A, P3 contains both qoky/oky and qokaiin/okaiin and contradicts that extra conjunction. Complement semantics is not adopted here.
This post-exposure authored rule has actual copy-expansion consequences but no native semantic confirmation. Historical903 and sister-gloss689 do not establish its Voynich binding.
